tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan brgyud gnad kyi mdo chings bzhugs so/ /snyan brgyud gnad kyi mdo chings zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub kun 'byung dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ / mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i zhabs btud de/ /zab don snying po'i mchog 'dir 'jug 'dod pas/ /snyan brgyud snyid po don gyi mdo chings bri/ /skal ldan dad pas nye bar gdungs pa can/ /chos don gnyer bas dam pa'i zhabs drung ngo*/ /snod ldan ngang tshul bzang po'i rtags yod pa/ /de la thog mar snod du rung ba'i chos/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs lung phog la/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing brtson pas gnas par bya/ /de nas zab lam dbang gi sgo phyes la/ /lam khrid chen mos nan tan snying por bya/ khyad par gzung 'dzin sems kyi rtsa ba gcad/ /dri ba gzabs la phu thag 'khrus par bya/ / dngos gzhi ngo sprod da lta'i nyams len gdab/ /zhag 'gar gsal gdab brtan chags rnyed par bya/ /ye grol sor bzhag dgongs pa'i gding chen bstan/ /snyan brgyud dang pos lta sgom spyod 'bras bstan/ /lam zab snying pos 'phyugs med thag chod bya/ /da lta'i yin lugs skyong lugs mi shes par/ /bar do'i lag brdas dgos dus stong par dka'/ /de bas da lta'i nyams len tshad la dbab/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras drod tshad rnyed par bya/ /'di ni thog ma'i gdams khrid mdo chings yin/ /de nas dngos gzhi bar do'i ngo sprod la/ /snyan brgyud gnyis pa don gyi me long bzhin/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngo sprod gzabs la bya/ khyad par dmar khrid lam gyi ngo sprod la/ /da lta rang gnas sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /bar do rang snang sku lnga ye shes gdangs/ /sgra 'od zer gsum thugs rje'i thag pa dang*/ /ngo sprod rnam bzhi lag khrid gzabs la sprad/ /shel dang 'dra 'bag 'od khyim kha sbyor gsum/ / 'du 'bral med pa nyi ma'i snying po bzhin/ /nges shes bskyaid la brda don 'phrod par bya/

/chos sku man shel nang gsal rin chen sbubs/ /rang bzhin 'od lnga sku gsum 'du bral med/ /thog ma'i gzhi dang gzhi snang ngo sprod yin/ / longs sku 'dra 'bag phyi gsal tshom bu'i sku/ /rang gdangs 'od lnga nam mkha'i dbyings shar ba/ lnga ldan dgongs par brda don nges shes bskyed/ /sku sprul 'od khyim kha sbyor sgron mar sprad/ /nang 'od snying ga phyi 'od nam mkha' gnyis/ /rgyang zhags sgo la 'od gsal kha sbyor yin/ /thugs rje'i zer snang sprul sku'i ngo sprod de/ /man shel nyi zer phyi nang kha sbyar bzhin/ /rtsal lam thugs rje'i zer thag ngo sprod yin/ /'di ni 'chi khar zer thag kha sbyar nyid/ / gzhi gnas rgya mtshor gnas bteg nam mkhar zug /dkar dmar zer gnyis rtse la lha mo brgyad/ /tshom bu'i skur snang zang thal grol ba yin/ /'du 'bral med pa nyi ma'i snying po ni/ /nyi 'od zer gsum sku gsum 'bral med des/ /da ltar rang gnas bar dor rang snang 'char/ /rang ngo shes pas rtogs pas rang grol dus/ /thugs rjes gzhan grol rdzogs ldan ngo sprod yin/ /de nas dbyings gcig rdzogs ldan chen po ni/ /chos sku man shel rin chen sbubs zhes bya/ /ngo sprod rnam bzhi don gyi snying po la/ /thig le nyag cig chos sku ngo sprod dang*/ /ma hā'i lnga ldan longs sku ngo sprod dang*/ /a nu'i 'od khyim sprul sku ngo sprod dang*/ /a ti rdzogs ldan 'du 'bral med ngo sprod/ /gzhi dang snang tshul nges rnyed grol ba ste/ /dgongs chen rnam bzhi rin chen sbubs gcig 'khyil/ /'di rnams rim pas gzabs la rang ngo sprad/ /ci yin cha med 'al 'ol mi bya bar/ /rang gis thog mar nges shes rab bskyed la/ /de rjes gzhan la dal bus bstan par bya/ /mtshon dpe mang yang rin chen man shel mchog /mtshon rtags mang yang tshon gang rang 'od mchog /mchog don mang yang rang rig chos sku mchog /dpe rtags don gsum rang mal chos skur bstan/

/brda don bshad la rgyal ba'i gral la bzhag /'di ni nges don gnad kyi man ngag yin/ /gnad la ma phog don nyid shes pa min/ /bskal par 'bad kyang grol ba shin tu dka'/ /'khor 'das rgyab gyes snang srid zhing khams shar/ /rang rig 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sbubs rnyed tshe/ /ye shes lus can rang ngo shes pas chog /phyi ru mi 'khyar thams cad sangs rgyas shing*/ /nang du mi 'khyar rang rig ye shes dngos/ /'khor ba'i yul sems de dus dong sbrug pas/ /mya ngan 'das pa rang snang sku gsum zhing*/ /dang po shes pas skad cig chos skur grol/ /longs sku'i zhal las sprul sku'i 'od 'phros pas/ /las dag 'phro la sprul pa dngos su snang*/ /sems can don byas snga phyi sprul pa brgyud/ /'gro don dpag med lhun gyis grub dbyings su/ /sprul pa longs sku de nyid chos skur 'dus/ /rin chen sbubs la rang sa rab tu zin/ / sbubs gsum gcig thim spyan gsum de bzhin no/ /'di ni gnad kyi sangs rgyas che ba'i chos/ /kun las 'phags pa don gyi snying po yin/ /snod ldan blo rab skal ba can rnams la/ /srid pa tha ma'i dam chos snying por bshad/ /de bas mkhas mchog rig 'dzin rgyal po che/ /'di 'dra'i don ston sprul pa'i gang zag dngos/ /des kyang bar do'i gnad rnams gzabs la sprad/ /de nas lta stangs gzig stangs rab bstun la/ /gsang sgo phye la 'od gsal nyi ma bstan/ /de la gnad gsum man ngag nyams len bya/ /yul dang sgo dang rig pa'i gnad gsum mo/ /lag khrid snying pos gdams pa'i gsal 'debs bya/ /kun la ma yin las can 'ga' yi yul/ /bla ma la gus dbang po mchog la bstan/ /'di nyid gsang ba dung gi yi ge las/ /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'di nyid 'brel/ /zhes gsungs mngon sum dngos su blta bar bya/ /de nas spros pa'i mtha' rnams gcad pa dang*/ /gsang chen nges pa'i theg pa mtha' rdzogs phyir/ /zab don me long rgyab chos chen mo bstan/

/de yi mun sangs nges don snying po rnyed/ /zab cing rgya che'i gnas la dbang 'byor thob/ /snod ldan 'ga' las kun la gsang bar bya/ /yang rab rnams la mngon phyung gsal bar bshad/ /de yi theg pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*/ / gdams pa'i snying po rtse mor shes pa dang*/ /snying po'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /las can skye bo tshe 'dir grol ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las mtha' ru rgyas pa dang*/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ / rang gi dge tshogs rgya mtsho gang ba dang*/ /lta dgongs ting 'dzin gong du 'phel la sogs/ /dpag med yon tan mtsho chen mi zad ldan/ /de phyir zab cing rgya che'i chos kyi sgo/ /gdams khrid lag len go rim ma nor bar/ /snod ldan rnams la rim gyis sbyin par bya/ /chos kha tshang bas nyams len snying po 'grub/ /snod med rnams la gsang zhing dam du sba/ /thos zin na yang gdams gzhug gnad rnams sba/ /nam yang mi sbyin chos kyi che ba nyams/ / bka' rgya zhig pas bka' chad 'byung ba yin/ /skal ldan bla ma la gus dbang po rab/ /dad brtson snying por byed la thams cad byin/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung na brgyud pa gtad/ /bka' rgya grol zhing gzhad don drin las bskul/ /'di ni nges par rang gnad dam pa yin/ /bdag gis tshul 'dir dka' ba mang spyad pas/ /snying po'i gnad rnams ma lus gsal bar mthong*/ /bla ma mnyes shing brgyud pa'i byin rlabs babs/ /de phyir rnam grangs nges pa'i don 'di bkod/ /phyi rabs dad ldan sems kyi bu rnams kun/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la nan tan bskyed/ /gdams khrid gnad rnams chings 'di ji bzhin thob/ /ma nor rnam grangs nges pa'i don la reg /de phyir zab don thig le gsang ba'i skor/ /mang thos snying po don gyi rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs rang grol klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par sbyar/ /dge ba de yis ma lus 'gro ba

kun/ /sus kyang ma 'bad cis kyang ma rtsol bar/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs ngo mtshar lhun gyis grub/ khams gsum yongs grol chos kyi rgyal por shog / snyan brgyud gnad kyi mdo chings zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa kun mkhyen sna tshogs rang grol gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ kun tu bzang po'i nags nang*/ zla ba chu shel gyi khang bzangs chos kyi mtho ba'i khri rab tu bzang po la sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)snyan brgyud gnad kyi mdo chings/ -PAGE 320--PAGE 321--PAGE 318-
